summary.para: Task settings for the document_extraction task type of the elastic service. They can be set when creating the inference endpoint and overridden per request. Request values take precedence, and parameters are merged per key.
The output format of the extracted content. Only markdown is supported.
A free-form object of extraction options that is forwarded to the Elastic Inference Service as-is. The accepted parameters are defined by the Elastic Inference Service.
